newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul building shrs hit by railway problem news.
newsitem.headline: Seoul building shrs hit by railway problem news.

text.p: Construction shares fell sharply in early Thursday trading on news a South Korean high-speed railway under construction has structural problems on some of its bridges, brokers said.
The construction sub-index dropped 6.6 points, or 2.37 percent, to 272.06 in early morning trading.

The railway will link Seoul with Pusan, running almost the entire length of South Korea from north to south. But the railway authority said safety problems might require partial rebuilding of some of its bridges.
"The news badly affected construction shares as investors fear companies involved will face penalties," said a Tongyang Securities broker.
Both Dae Ho Construction and Il Sung Construction went limit-down, shedding 1,700 won and 520 won to 20,500 and 5,980 respectively. Hyundai Housing and Industrial Development lost 500 won to 12,600.
